title: Beyond Guess and Check: Quantifying the Fidelity of Proxy Applications
problem: No consistent method for quantifying proxy application fidelity to parent applications
motivation: Proxy apps essential for system design but difficult to validate; no principled way to measure how well proxies capture parent behaviors
method: Calder toolkit using similarity algorithms and Laplacian scores with correlation filters to identify important HPC application features
key_novelty: Algorithmic toolkit for quantifying proxy fidelity; identifies feature importance for proxy-parent behavior matching
contributions: Feature importance identification using Laplacian scores
Validation on kernel behavior, network counters, cross-platform performance
75% of proxies show highly convergent behavior with parents
limitations: Scope limited to proxy suite tested; depends on feature selection
